description: Reads the registrant list of one webinar: name, email, signup time, attended, watched replay, purchased, UTM source, and what each registrant spent. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Personal data is returned only when the host's licence includes the registrant export (export_leads). Without that licence the site answers with the code license_required and an upgrade link, and no personal data is returned. Use it when the host asks who registered, how many leads came in, whom to follow up, or what a single lead bought. Do not use it for aggregate numbers (that is wi_get_webinar_funnel_conversion_stats), for deleting data or for exporting a file. Without a connected site the answer carries example numbers marked sample: true, from a static demo file that contains no real person.

limit.description: How many registrants to return, 1-200. Default 50.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out when the session already built one.

name: wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants
title: List webinar registrants and leads
